$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8790 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($listener in $listeners) { $owner = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId=' + $listener.OwningProcess); if ($owner.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $owner.CommandLine -match 'Qualitzer-Mobile' -and $owner.CommandLine -match 'serve-apk\.cjs') { Stop-Process -Id $owner.ProcessId } else { throw 'PORT_8790_BELONGS_TO_ANOTHER_PROCESS' } }; & 'C:\Users aust\Desktop\www\Qualitzer-Mobile
